newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds end quiet, soymeal untraded.
newsitem.headline: European feeds end quiet, soymeal untraded.

text.p: Sharply higher prices on offer for South American soymeal in Europe on Friday kept buyers at a distance and by the close no trades in it had been reported.

Material was offered up to five dollars higher a tonne this morning, in line with Chicago's much firmer close on Thursday. But a milder opening to U.S. business on Friday served to prove the buyers right, traders said.
Only scattered trades were reported, with most interest in the Argentine sunmeal pellets, which traded afloat at $158 and for the Jan/Mch and Oct/Dec positions at $162 a tonne.
